lines: Only a scorch on the stone where the shard lay.
A piece of the moon, as long as your arm, cold as river water. The Thornback sleeps beside it, calm now.
You wrap the shard in your mantle. It is lighter than it looks.
The stone figure's eye slits glow faintly amber, then fade. Not yet.
A figure of granite slabs, half sunk into the wall, turf growing on its shoulders. It looks almost like it is waiting.
